description: This file contains the implementation of the StaticMap class template, including methods for construction, searching (find, lower_bound, upper_bound), validation, and key retrieval, used for in-memory static mapping with binary search.

classes.name: StaticMap
classes.description: A template class implementing a static, in-memory key-value map with binary search capabilities.

methods.name: StaticMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map from raw data.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Performs binary search to find a key in the map.

methods.name: lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element not less than the given key.

methods.name: upper_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element greater than the given key.

methods.name: ValidateInMemoryStructure
methods.description: Checks the integrity and consistency of the in-memory data structure.

methods.name: GetKeyAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the key at a specific index.
